title.narrative: 23F-Solidaridad UG - Harvesting Carbon: Pioneering a Pay-for-Impact Model for Carbon Mitigation and Adaptation in Coffee

description.narrative: This project will contribute immensely towards: poverty reduction through improved incomes and livelihoods for farmers; significant transfer of knowledge and skills through this program from world class institutions to local farmers; an increase in access to international markets, diversifying income streams and earning foreign exchange for Uganda; innovation in the sustainable management of forests, farmlands, reducing deforestation and biodiversity loss, etc. Uganda’s national development agenda is presented in the Third National Development Plan. Of the 5 stated key objectives of the development plan our project contributes towards 4: Enhance value addition in key growth opportunities; Strengthen the private sector to create jobs; Consolidate and increase the stock and quality of productive infrastructure; Enhance the productivity and social wellbeing of the population.
